message:
test(rel-0164 old-ref): DIAGNOSTIC only -- the control channel's ACK / head record on the test host's "udp control session ended" line (header fields only), the same diff as the candidate side

Codex codex_old_apk_lane_peer_lost_decision_r1.md: when the host closes, which control message was waiting for its ACK
(seq, attempts, fragments, queue depth, first / last send, its type from the payload's MessageHeader -- the header's
type field only), the same head as it stood when retransmits ran out (peer-lost), and the ACKs this host SAW (its stream,
another stream, after it had closed) against those it ACCEPTED (stale / probe / NACK apart); the receive side's last
delivered seq. A socket send is not an ACK: only HandleAck popping the head counts as accepted.

Compiled ONLY with REMOTE60_CONTROL_CLOSE_DIAG -- set on GNLinkStreamPinnedSelectTest (its own copy of the host sources)
and on the new remote60_udp_control_close_diag_test; GNLinkStream (the product) builds without it. udp_control_channel
is the same blob in fae0e1f and 53fced4 (71be7daf / cf7c173c); this diff to it is byte-identical on both sides
(results 31dcfffd / 9eb7520c). Reset() starts a new session's record.

Test: udp_control_close_diag_test (two real channels in memory): a peer that never ACKs -> peer-lost, lost{seq=1
type=37 attempts=4}, accepted=0, no payload text past the header; its ACKs delivered late -> afterClose=2, still
accepted=0; a normal exchange -> accepted=3, head{none}, lost{none}.
